note: IMAP head + provisioning: POST /imap/provision creates an account (argon2id) with its INBOX and drops a hello record into it; POST /imap/folders creates a role-tagged folder with a per-verb policy; GET /imap/folders lists the account's mailboxes. The account is then readable by any mail client on 127.0.0.1:1143, and the `_imap` stack observes client mutations (and refuses appends into role "readonly"). Binds localhost → imap-demo for the routes and pony.local.thanks.computer (dev-local, auto-verified) as the domain the username must belong to. Needs `txco dev --imap`.

checks.name: provision creates the account and returns the password once
re-provision updates in place, no new password, hello is a noop
a domain the tenant does not own is refused
missing username is a 400 before any op runs
a role-tagged folder with a stack policy
folders list shows INBOX with the hello and the new folder
a folder for an unknown account is refused
